briefings.title: Coursera's Founder Predicts The Future Of AI And Biology
briefings.tldr: Daphne Koller, Co-Founder of Coursera and Founder & CEO of Insitro, outlines her journey from academic pioneer to industry disruptor, detailing how she leverages AI and massive biological datasets to create predictive models ("virtual humans") and discover disease-modifying therapies for devastating conditions like ALS.
